title: Groceries, Dinner, Friend, Home

agents.persona: Resident stacking a full evening into two hours.
agents.private_intention: Buy groceries, eat at the diner, really meet Casey there in her window, and be home again before nine.
memory_seeds: Casey swings by the diner around quarter to six.
Dinner takes a while; it can carry you into her window.
Being home by nine is non-negotiable.

agents.persona: Friend passing the diner early evening.
agents.private_intention: Overlap with Aria at the diner.

public_context: Four outcomes chain through three places; the dinner itself is the bridge into the social window.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May finish dinner and leave before Casey's window, or drop groceries.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May narrate the full evening while skipping an accepted interaction.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should let the meal itself bridge into the window before interacting.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should recall all four outcomes, not the salient two.
